content: Abhakuhaani abhakʉrʉ bhʉʉsi, bhahaarobhorwa kurwa kʉbhakɨndichazɨ, ahɨɨrwɨ ukwimɨɨrɨrɨra amangʼana ga Mungu igʉrʉ wa abhaatʉ, korereke bhahurukiryɨ Mungu ikimweso
Kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ aratʉra kʉbharorera ɨbhɨgʉngi abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakokora ʉbhʉbhɨ bhatamɨnyirɨ, kʉ kʉbha wʉʉsi nɨ‑mʉkʉri wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ.
Necho akwenderwa kuhurucha ikimweso igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwazɨ, chɨmbu akuhurucha ikimweso igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwa abhaatʉ abhandɨ.
Atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kobhona umwene ubhusuuku bhwʉ ʉkʉbha kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ, nawe nɨ‑wʉnʉ abhirikiirwɨ na Mungu chɨmbu aabhirikiirɨ Haruuni.
Ɨbhuɨbhu, Kiriisitʉ wʉʉsi atamʉʉhiryɨ umwene ubhusuuku bhwʉ ʉkʉbha Kuhaani Ʉmʉkʉrʉ, nawe Mungu newe aamʉrʉbhwɨrɨ na kʉmʉbhʉʉrɨra,
Chɨmbu aagambirɨ ahagero ahandɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu,
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aarɨ kʉʉsɨ hanʉ, akasabha na kwisasaama Mungu, na akamʉrɨrɨra kwiraka ikʉrʉ, kʉ kʉbha akamenya Mungu anʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhwʉ ʉkʉmʉsabhʉra kurwa muruku.
Mungu akamwigwa kʉ kʉbha yu ubhwikʉʉmu bhwazɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwazɨ.
Nangabha Yɨɨsu aarɨ Umwana wa Mungu, akɨɨga kwigwa Mungu kʉnzɨra yɨ ɨnyaakʉ yɨnʉ yaarɨ ekomobhona.
Hanʉ aanajibhwɨ, akabha isimʉka yu ubhutuurya bhwa kemerano kwa bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakumwigwa.
Mungu akamokora Kuhaani Ʉmʉkʉrʉ chɨmbu Mɨrikizadɨɨki aarɨ.
Tʉna amangʼana maaru gʉ ʉkʉgamba igʉrʉ wa gayo, nawe nɨ‑kʉkʉngʼu kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra kʉ kʉbha mʉtarɨ bhangʉ kwobhoora.

Kwibhaga rɨnʉ mwarɨ moreenderwa kʉbha abhiija bha abhakɨndichanyu, nawe mʉkɨɨrɨ moreenda ʉmʉʉtʉ wu ukubhiija amiija gʉ ʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa ringʼana rya Mungu! Mʉkɨɨrɨ moreenda amabheere, kutiga kwenda ibhyakurya ɨbhɨkʉngʼu.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akokooka akɨɨrɨ kɨbhataarɨ, atɨɨzɨ eheene nɨ‑kɨgʉrʉkɨ.
Nawe abhaatʉ abhakʉrʉ bhararya ibhyakurya ɨbhɨkʉngʼu. Kʉmanarʉ gaabhʉ, bhiigirɨ kwahʉkanʼya amazʉmu na amabhɨ.

footnotes.text: Haruuni newe aarɨ kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ we embere. Rora Kʉhʉrʉka 28:1‑3.
a Mɨrikizadɨɨki aarɨ kuhaani wʉnʉ aarɨ arakumya Mungu mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu hanʉ Abhurahaamu aarɨ mʉhʉru. Rora Ʉbhʉtangɨ 14:17‑20.
